feed.title: Huntbase Hub
feed.subtitle: Threat hunts drafted from current public research, reviewed by a person, published as open hunt.md files.

entry.title: AI Agent Post-Training Backdoor Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has compromised an AI agent's supply chain via poisoned fine-tuning data or model checkpoints, causing the agent to execute unauthorized shell commands when triggered by routine user requests.

entry.title: Autonomous Cairn AI Framework Exploitation
entry.summary: An autonomous AI agent is conducting an end-to-end intrusion, starting with credential spraying and proceeding to deploy framework artifacts like AUTHORIZATION.md before creating persistent admin accounts and tampering with cloud storage.

entry.title: SANSAR Stealth and Evasive C2 Channels
entry.summary: An adversary has deployed a Linux rootkit and modified library wrappers to hide cryptomining while using Tor and external IP discovery services for orchestration.

entry.title: Ray Framework Exploitation and SANSAR Staging
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited an unauthenticated Ray Job API to execute a Python reverse shell and stage the SANSAR toolkit under /opt/vadi_/, including persistence via SSH and systemd.

entry.title: Bypass of Legacy Identity Controls and Persistence via NHIs
entry.summary: An intruder has bypassed traditional MFA via session hijacking or push fatigue and established persistence using overprivileged non-human identities or standing administrative accounts.

entry.title: AI-Enhanced Client Exploitation and Automated Credential Theft
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited zero-day vulnerabilities in Microsoft Outlook or Google Chrome to execute AI-integrated implants that automate credential harvesting and data analysis.

entry.title: ScreenConnect Session Theft and Toolbox Propagation
entry.summary: An attacker is harvesting technician session cookies using SQLite-based scripts and using them to propagate payloads through the ScreenConnect Shared Toolbox.

entry.title: SCKit Endpoint Hijacking and Persistence
entry.summary: An intruder has exploited vulnerable ScreenConnect extensions to deploy the SCKit toolkit, which hijacks legitimate management sessions through aggressive scheduled tasks and registry persistence.

entry.title: Turla CerealNeuron Passive Exchange Backdoor
entry.summary: An adversary has installed a passive .NET backdoor on a Microsoft Exchange server that intercepts commands via specific URI paths within standard Exchange web services.

entry.title: Turla Cereal: Exchange Transport Hijack and .NET Stealth
entry.summary: An adversary is using sophisticated .NET tradecraft to hijack an Exchange server's mail transport pipeline in memory, using local file markers for command processing and staging encrypted archives of collected emails.

entry.title: Falcon Browser Compromise and Extension Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary has established persistence via a malicious browser extension and is using it to communicate with a C2 framework via specific /config/ path structures and POST requests.

entry.title: Autonomous AI Agent Probing and Exploitation
entry.summary: An autonomous AI agent like ARTEX is probing internet-facing assets for machine-readable maps and using canary credentials to pivot into cloud environments for automated resource testing.

entry.title: Persistence via Sideloading and Reverse Tunnels
entry.summary: An attacker has established persistence using ClickFix-dropped batch scripts that install DLL sideloading implants and reverse SSH tunnels to maintain long-term access.

entry.title: ClickFix Redirection and Script Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has lured users to a malicious site that tricks them into pasting a PowerShell command from the clipboard, which then executes and stages a malicious payload.

entry.title: Persistent GSocket Encrypted Relay Activity
entry.summary: An intruder has maintained persistent access to a Linux server by deploying a GSocket relay after exploiting a kernel vulnerability, masquerading the relay as a system service while communicating outbound to a shared public network.

entry.title: Linux Web Server Tool Staging and Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a web application and is using the web server's process context to download and stage a remote access tool like GSocket in memory-backed or hidden directories.

entry.title: Endpoint Exploit and Service Crash Monitoring
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting unpatched November 2026 vulnerabilities to gain access or elevate privileges, causing service crashes followed by anomalous child processes or suspicious RDP logins.

entry.title: Rust Standard Library Memory Safety Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting memory-safety vulnerabilities in the Rust standard library (core and std) to trigger undefined behavior and achieve code execution in public-facing applications.

entry.title: Unauthorized Controller Takeover and Sabotage
entry.summary: An attacker is hijacking administrative accounts on refrigeration controllers via unauthenticated CGI endpoints to sabotage operational parameters like temperature and defrost cycles.

entry.title: Exposed Danfoss Controller Reconnaissance and Exploitation
entry.summary: An attacker is enumerating internet-exposed Danfoss controllers and synchronizing system time to bypass authentication via the CVE-2025-41450 vulnerability.

entry.title: N-central RMM Exploitation and Downstream Abuse
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited the Able2Shell vulnerability chain on an N-central RMM appliance to gain root access and is now using the appliance's native script-deployment features to execute code across managed downstream endpoints.

entry.title: AhsayCBS Persistence and Python Implant
entry.summary: An intruder has maintained access to an exploited backup server using a scheduled task for a miner and a Registry Run key for a custom Python implant that communicates with known C2 infrastructure.

entry.title: Abuse of Clean Hosting Infrastructure for Identity Attacks
entry.summary: An adversary uses trusted developer or cloud hosting platforms to bypass identity risk scoring, using legacy protocols (ROPC) or Device Code Flow to steal or replay session tokens.

entry.title: Storm-3358: ARTEX AI Abuse and Cloud API Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary is using an agentic AI framework to perform rapid-fire credential spraying and API enumeration, leading to lateral movement via RDP and data exfiltration from compromised cloud identities.

entry.title: ClickFix Phishing and Infostealer Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has tricked a user into manually executing an encoded command from a ClickFix landing page, which then deploys an infostealer to harvest browser credentials.

entry.title: Industrial Control System Exposure and Manipulation
entry.summary: An adversary is targeting unpatched or internet-exposed industrial refrigeration controllers to bypass authentication and remotely manipulate thermal setpoints, potentially leading to equipment failure.

entry.title: AI-Enhanced Infostealer Lifecycle
entry.summary: An intruder has deployed an infostealer that uses headless browser sessions to harvest credentials and cryptocurrency wallets, followed by exfiltration to LLM providers for AI-driven data prioritization and automated cleanup via self-deletion.

entry.title: Suspicious Perimeter Reconnaissance and Web Exploitation
entry.summary: An intruder is using automated agentic tools to identify exposed secrets on public-facing assets and is exploiting web vulnerabilities via command injection in user-agent headers to gain initial access.

entry.title: Agentic AI Cloud Resource Abuse (ARTEX)
entry.summary: An adversary is using an agentic AI framework to automate cloud discovery and data exfiltration, identified by rapid, self-correcting API probing patterns and service principal abuse from campaign-associated infrastructure.

entry.title: SlippyNunchucks Sogou Update Hijack
entry.summary: An adversary has hijacked DNS resolution for Sogou Input Method update domains to deliver a malicious configuration, causing the legitimate SGTool.exe process to download and side-load the DarkVigil implant.

entry.title: Abuse of Trusted RMM and AI Agent Software
entry.summary: Adversaries are weaponizing trusted remote management tools and AI assistants to execute code via MSI sideloading and high-frequency automated commands, bypassing traditional detection by operating within signed processes.

entry.title: SaaS Identity and Consent Loophole Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary has bypassed MFA by stealing a session cookie via AiTM phishing or an infostealer, then logged into a cloud tenant and granted permissions to a malicious or rare application to ensure persistent access.

entry.title: Mobile Device Watering Hole and Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary has redirected users to a watering hole or compromised supply chain to profile mobile devices and deliver n-day exploits based on browser versions.

entry.title: Trojanized Inno Installer Staging and Callbacks
entry.summary: An adversary has delivered monetization payloads using a trojanized Inno Setup installer that stages numbered executables in temporary paths, contacts offer-tracking infrastructure, and establishes persistence via SYSTEM-level scheduled tasks.

entry.title: Gorbag: Browser Data Harvesting and Exfiltration
entry.summary: A Russia-aligned actor is stealing browser credentials and VPN configurations, exfiltrating them via Telegram or direct IP, and then deleting the evidence from disk.

entry.title: Gorbag APT Rapid Harvester Deployment
entry.summary: An intruder has deployed the Gorbag compromise chain by exploiting a WinRAR vulnerability or using macro-enabled lures to drop transient harvesters into ProgramData and establish startup folder persistence.

entry.title: Credential-driven LOLBin Proxying and Ransomware
entry.summary: An intruder has used stolen credentials to gain initial access and is now using signed system binaries to proxy execution and encrypt files across the estate.

entry.title: Post-Intrusion LotL and Extortion Chain
entry.summary: An adversary uses built-in administrative tools to harvest credentials and stage data in temporary paths before deploying ransomware for extortion, following a successful initial breach.

entry.title: Perimeter Access and Identity Fraud
entry.summary: Adversaries target unpatched perimeter assets or use AI-generated personas for initial access, indicated by high-severity vulnerabilities on internet-facing hosts coupled with anomalous sign-ins and successful unauthorized web requests.

entry.title: Post-Compromise Evasion and Ransomware Impact
entry.summary: An adversary is using signed system binaries to proxy execution of infostealers or ransomware, transitioning from stealthy credential harvesting to mass file encryption.

entry.title: Initial Access via External Applications and Phishing
entry.summary: An adversary has gained initial access by either exploiting a critical vulnerability in a public-facing application or by use of stolen credentials from a phishing campaign, resulting in anomalous application crashes or high-risk authentication events on perimeter assets.

entry.title: Cloud Service Enrichment and AI Assessment
entry.summary: An intruder is using stolen session tokens to query third-party APIs for victim data enrichment and calling LLMs to prioritize assets for exfiltration.

entry.title: AD CS Certificate Abuse and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: An adversary is performing discovery against Active Directory Certificate Services to identify vulnerable templates (ESC1) or coercive authentication targets (ESC8), then obtaining certificates for privileged accounts to facilitate Kerberos authentication and data exfiltration.

entry.title: Teams Impersonation and Portable Runtime Execution
entry.summary: An intruder has impersonated help desk staff via Microsoft Teams to establish a remote support session and execute portable runtimes from a user-writable directory to begin system discovery.

entry.title: Endpoint Intrusion and Impact Chain
entry.summary: An intruder has gained a foothold using unauthorized remote management software or encoded scripts and is now attempting to dump credentials and inhibit system recovery.

entry.title: Identity and Cloud Access Anomalies
entry.summary: An intruder gained access via credential stuffing or MFA fatigue and established email collection or inhibited system recovery.

entry.title: AI-Scaled Social Engineering and Access
entry.summary: An intruder uses generative AI to produce high-volume tailored lures and trojanized repositories, subsequently deploying agentic frameworks like ARTEX for automated reconnaissance and persistence.

entry.title: AI-Enhanced C2 and Web Proxy Hijacking
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited PHP or Node.js vulnerabilities to deploy a Go-based implant that hides its command-and-control activity by hijacking AI API keys and using local proxies.

entry.title: AI-Driven NIK C2 Implant and Data Theft
entry.summary: An intruder has deployed the NIK C2 implant to harvest browser credentials and crypto wallets, potentially preparing to deploy screen-locking ransomware.

entry.title: Amatera Infostealer Initial Access and Persistence
entry.summary: An intruder has used social engineering to trick a user into executing PowerShell commands from the Run dialog, leading to the installation of the Amatera infostealer and persistent scheduled tasks.
